title: Prepare a compact-rotor packet and distinguish its inertia with a finite-aperture binary meter
statement: An isolated gapped normal ramp from the declared N=0/cosine momentum stock, followed by hold t*=2pi B hbar/P_*^2, has a controlled full-state error relative to a packet with cosine contrast2/(3pi). A C2 compact profile h_L(Y)=eta(Y/L)cos(kY), L=40/k, and a finite qubit pulse retain a reference gap>3/80 and an actual gap>1/40 under the stated error allocation.

requires: Actual isolated canonical primitive, fresh declared packet/rotor/qubit stocks, permitted flux window throughout the ramp, switches, controlled lock harmonics, finite hold and C2 calibrated readout profile.
provides: An isolated gapped normal ramp from the declared N=0/cosine momentum stock, followed by hold t*=2pi B hbar/P_*^2, has a controlled full-state error relative to a packet with cosine contrast2/(3pi). A C2 compact profile h_L(Y)=eta(Y/L)cos(kY), L=40/k, and a finite qubit pulse retain a reference gap>3/80 and an actual gap>1/40 under the stated error allocation.
assumptions: This operation supplies a bounded final record, not uniform actual long-hold Y variance, loaded Gibbs preparation or live heat. The logarithmic-b fixed-P preparation window must be rechecked for the stronger live lock.
costs: Pay stock, ramp work/amplitude/slew, hold proportional to B, profile active length4L, finite meter amplitude/slew, reference frame and detector confidence. Finite coupling work does not acquire field-generator energy/mass.
contract.units: k=P_*/hbar is inverse length; L=40/k is length; t* is time; error budgets, binary contrast and probabilities are dimensionless.
contract.obstruction: Finite coupling norm alone does not provide a finite field apparatus or a lead-coupled thermal experiment.

body: Use the monotone-density Poincare gap and small-flux minmax window, then finite Fourier Galerkin adiabatic bounds with actual amplitude/phase errors. A global phase-corrector gives the whole-band hold envelope. The reference variance, not an inferred actual variance, bounds finite-aperture loss. The native commutator for h(Y) and the actual force/momentum bound control the noncommuting finite meter. Fresh supplied stocks and calibrated positive detector contrast permit bounded binary concentration.
